title: Pakistan’s viral cricket catch star hopes to launch career
html:
Pakistan's viral cricket catch star hopes to launch career

The motorbike passenger who went viral for his stunning cricket catch in Pakistan says he hopes to play for his country one day. Mehran Khan, a government worker from the Swat Valley, became an internet sensation when the video was shared around the world.
summary: The motorbike passenger who went viral for his stunning cricket catch in Pakistan says he hopes to play for his country.
